SELECT caps.*, ( SELECT scv.MEANING FROM sys_code_b sc, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID AND sc.CODE = 'FINANCING_LOAN' AND scv.value = caps.CREDIT_TYPE ) AS CREDIT_TYPE_N, cap.issue_amount, nvl( round( caps.subscribe_amount / cap.issue_amount , 4 ), 0 ) AS sub_percent, apst.project_grade, apst.predict_rate, lcc.credit_con_number, hcl.valid_from, hcl.valid_to, hcl.document_type, lccl.credit_category, hcl.actual_available_amt actual_credit_amt, (select s.MEANING from sys_code_value_b_v s where s.CODE_VALUE = caps.SUBSCRIBE_TYPE and s.code = 'ABS.INVESTOR_SUBSCRIPTION_TYPE') as SUBSCRIBE_TYPE_N,
caps.SUBSCRIBE_LEVEL as SUBSCRIBE_LEVEL_N, caps.SUBSCRIBE_ACCOUNT_NAME as SUBSCRIBE_ACCOUNT_NAME_N, caba.bank_account_name AS TARGET_ACCOUNT_NAME_N,
(select s.MEANING from sys_code_value_b_v s where s.CODE_VALUE = CAPS.RELE_COM_FLAG and s.code = 'SYS.YES_NO') as RELE_COM_FLAG_N, (select s.MEANING from sys_code_value_b_v s where s.CODE_VALUE = CAPS.RELE_CREDIT_FLAG and s.code = 'SYS.YES_NO') as RELE_CREDIT_FLAG_N,
lcc.credit_con_number AS CREDIT_CON_NUMBER_N
FROM ct_abs_product_subscribe caps join ct_abs_product cap on cap.product_id=caps.product_id left join ct_abs_product_structure apst on apst.structure_id=caps.structure_id left join lon_credit_line_calc hcl on hcl.credit_line_id=caps.credit_line_id left join lon_credit_contract_line lccl on lccl.credit_line_id=hcl.credit_line_id left join lon_credit_contract lcc on lcc.credit_contract_id=caps.credit_contract_id left join ct_abs_bank_account caba on caba.abs_bank_account_id=caps.payment_target where 1=1
and caps.product_id = #{productId}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ct_abs_product_subscribe caps LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pr.subscribe_id, SUM(pr.release_amount) al_release_amount FROM ct_abs_product_release pr WHERE pr.release_status='CONFIRM' GROUP BY pr.subscribe_id) cbpr ON cbpr.subscribe_id=caps.subscribe_id WHERE caps.rele_credit_flag='Y' AND caps.subscribe_status='CONFIRM' AND nvl(caps.subscribe_amount,0)-nvl(cbpr.al_release_amount,0)>0 AND caps.product_id = #{productId}
